name: co-op-game-intro-generator
title_zh: 双人游戏开场菜单，先出定妆稿再动工
tagline_zh: 给两位玩家起好名、定好画风，它先锁死身份线索出一张确认图；配色、按钮、图标、字体全按这套来。
tagline_en: Give two player names, a title, and an art style. It locks identity cues into a fixed menu framework—colors.
desc_en: For users creating a two-player co-op game menu or opening animation. Users provide two player names, a game title, a target visual style, and optional character reference images. The Skill locks identity cues, generates an approval image from a fixed menu framework with coordinated color, buttons, icons, and typography, then uses the approved result to rebuild the character, UI-copy, and event ti
why_zh: 不是直接生成最终图，而是先用固定菜单框架出审批图，把风格分歧扼杀在动工前，避免返工重画整套界面。
why_en: De-risks style mismatch by forcing an approval gate on a fixed menu framework before any full rebuild, so you don't waste effort.
limit_zh: 只服务双人合作游戏的开场菜单或过场动画；需提供两名玩家名、游戏标题、目标视觉风格。
limit_en: Only for two-player co-op game menus or intros. Needs 2 player names, a game title, and a target style. Character refs optional but identity lock.
title_en: Two-player game intro menu: approval image first, then build
